name: Fortune Cats Golden Stacks!!

features.name: Extra play areas
features.description: Up to 120 lines in the bonus.

review:
Lucky cats on 40 lines, with mystery symbols and golden stacks. The bonus adds extra play areas, raising the line count to 120.

Those extra areas are the main attraction, tripling your chances on every spin. Thunderkick lists a 96.14% RTP and a 2,500x cap, and publishes a number for volatility rather than a label. A light, cheerful game.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Thunderkick doesn't publish a volatility label for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
